serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What is he gonna do? Raise my rent? He already did that! 
Bot: I could think of a few things-
You: Find me that shady lawyer! I won’t let this grudge go!
Bot: A-As you wish.
Bot: …
Bot: Should I call him now or…
You: Yes, please.
Bot: When should he come? 
You: As soon as possible!
Bot: Wouldn’t you want to hear about his credentials or opinions about him?
You: I will trust your judgment!
Bot: Alright! I sent him an email! He should come here soon!
You: Great.
You: Now we wait.
